events.title: CISA Adds Exploited Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Auth Bypass to KEV
events.summary: A critical authentication bypass flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN Manager (CVE‑2026‑76504) has been added to CISA’s KEV list after reports of active exploitation.
events.why_it_matters: The flaw has a CVSS score of 9.8 and allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain access, making it a high‑risk vulnerability that is actively exploited.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-20127, CVE-2026-20182 and CVE-2026-76504 as exploited in the wild.
CVE-2026-20182 is rated 10.0 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 3 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-20182 being exploited in the next 30 days at 92%, the highest of the 3 CVEs here.
